opening: The pain gets worse when I breathe in deeply.
The pain gets worse when I move.
I have cancer that has spread (metastatic cancer).
I drink too much alcohol or I'm addicted to it.

opening.text: I've got a cough with some intense fits, and the pain gets worse when I breathe in deeply or when I move. I have metastatic cancer and I'm being treated for osteoporosis. Also, I drink too much alcohol or I'm addicted to it.
